#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

# Read version.json, bump patch, write back, and create tag.txt
VERSION_FILE="version.json"
TAG_FILE="tag.txt"

# Parse current version using python for reliable JSON handling
read -r major minor patch < <(python3 -c "
import json
v=json.load(open('$VERSION_FILE'))
print(v['major'], v['minor'], v['patch']+1)
")

# Write bumped version back to version.json
python3 -c "
import json
v=json.load(open('$VERSION_FILE'))
v['patch']=v['patch']+1
json.dump(v, open('$VERSION_FILE','w'))
"

# Write tag.txt with v<major>.<minor>.<patch>
echo "v${major}.${minor}.${patch}" > "$TAG_FILE"
